widgets_values:
## R2V 편집 · 이미지와 VFX LoRA 없이 사용 가능

입력: 원본 영상 + 구조화된 편집 지시.
1. 영상을 넣고 효과 선택에서 00 직접 입력을 고릅니다.
2. 직접 입력 프롬프트를 자신의 장면에 맞게 고칩니다.
3. 실행합니다. VFX LoRA용 vfx_edit: 문장과 다른 형식입니다.
선택 이미지: 이미지 노드와 메인 노드의 참고 이미지 사용을 둘 다 켭니다.
선택 보호 합성: 마스크 영상과 보호 합성 노드를 켜고 저장 입력을 보호 합성 출력으로 연결합니다. 흰색=바꿀 곳, 검정=원본.

실행 전 필요한 모델을 선택하세요. 이번 정리에서는 GPU 생성을 실행하지 않았습니다.
nodes.title: R2V 편집 · 이미지와 VFX LoRA 없이 사용 가능
수정본 사용 안내
widgets_values:
기본은 마스크 없이 생성합니다.

보호 합성을 사용할 때만 마스크 입력과 보호 합성 그룹을 모두 활성화하고 마스크를 넣으세요. 이제 저장 노드가 보호 합성 그룹의 출력을 받습니다. 그룹을 끄면 첫 입력인 생성 영상이 통과합니다.

흰색=바꿀 곳. 원본·마스크의 시작점, 길이, FPS를 맞추세요.

⟦01 폭풍우 · Thunderstorm⟧
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit; it is the strict motion reference, and its motion timing and playback speed define every frame of the target video.
<Subject 1> is the original scene in <Video 1>: every person, object, surface and background element with their exact positions, appearance and frame-by-frame motion, seen through the original camera framing and movement.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The weather becomes a powerful cinematic thunderstorm with heavy wind-driven rain and occasional distant lightning. Every person keeps their identity, face, hair, clothing, body proportions and frame-by-frame movement.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (whole-video timing, framing and camera movement): fully_preserved - the shot length, frame-by-frame timing, playback speed, composition, perspective, lens and camera path are retained; each frame of the target video shows the same moment as the same frame of <Video 1>.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - all people, objects and the scene layout are retained; the weather, light and surface wetness change.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic live-action edit of <Video 1> with high-end cinematic visual effects.
[Shot 1] Dense layered charcoal and midnight-blue clouds roll overhead wherever sky is visible. Heavy diagonal rain falls through the scene at several depths, with small splashes, shallow puddles, wet surfaces and soft reflections on existing materials. Every few seconds a distant cold white-blue lightning flash briefly lights the clouds and surroundings, then fades smoothly. The light turns cold blue-gray with moving cloud shadows and moist air. The wind moves only the added rain and mist; hair, clothing, vegetation and objects keep the motion they have in <Video 1>. Throughout the single continuous shot, the camera movement, framing and every movement of <Subject 1> follow <Video 1> exactly from the first frame to the last, at the original playback speed: each movement starts and ends at the same moment as in <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain hisses steadily, drops patter on surfaces and distant thunder rolls after each lightning flash.
